properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] AI/LLM Agent Framework Runtime Spawning Shell, Recon, or Egress Child Process
properties.description:
Detects a public-facing AI/LLM agent-framework runtime (Langflow/uvicorn, PraisonAI AgentOS, LobeHub, Crawl4AI, Rclone rcd, or the npm/Node MCPServer) spawning an OS shell, reconnaissance utility, or network-egress tool — the post-exploitation behaviour that turns an unauthenticated RCE primitive into hands-on-keyboard execution. It matters this fortnight because a cluster of CRITICAL GHSAs landed against these frameworks (CVE-2026-48519 'Langflow Shareable Playground RCE', CVE-2026-55450 'Langflow unauthenticated upload', CVE-2026-49980 'Rclone rcd inline-remote command exec', CVE-2026-54157 'LobeHub /webapi/proxy SSRF', the PraisonAI Jobs-API/AgentOS/MCPServer/AgentTeam.launch unauthenticated-invocation set, and 'Crawl4AI Chromium launch-argument injection') — all exploit T1190 then pivot to T1059, and the IOCs (endpoints, ports) differ per product so only the parent→child execution chain generalises. It spans the exploit and install kill-chain stages: the framework process is the initiating parent, the shell/LOLBin is the child. It fires when one of these runtimes (or a Chromium child launched with --no-zygote plus a subprocess-launcher switch) directly spawns sh/bash/cmd/powershell/curl/wget/nc/whoami and similar; it does NOT fire on normal agent inference, model downloads via the framework's own HTTP client, or interactive developer shells whose parent is a terminal rather than the server runtime. Because these frameworks have no legitimate reason to fork a system shell in production, the parent-child pair is alert-grade.

Rationale: Every article is an unauthenticated RCE/command-exec primitive in a different AI/LLM framework whose only shared, IOC-independent signal is the server runtime forking a shell or recon/egress tool — matching on the parent-runtime→child-tool pair catches the joint pattern while staying immune to the per-product endpoints and ports that rotate.
properties.query:
// Microsoft Sentinel — auto-derived from the Defender XDR hunt.
// Requires the Microsoft 365 Defender data connector (streams the
// advanced-hunting tables into Sentinel; Timestamp → TimeGenerated).
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python","python3","python.exe","uvicorn","gunicorn","node","node.exe","rclone","rclone.exe","chrome.exe","chromium")
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("langflow","praisonai","agentos","crawl4ai","lobehub","uvicorn","gunicorn"))
| where FileName in~ ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","ksh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","nc","ncat","socat","whoami","id","perl","ruby","php","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
    or (ProcessCommandLine has "--no-zygote" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--utility-cmd-prefix","--renderer-cmd-prefix","--gpu-launcher","--browser-subprocess-path"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Count=count(), SampleChildCmd=any(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName
| order by LastSeen desc
